scope: Encoded: s 66; s 67(a), (b) (both limbs, with four named refusals for the shapes of family the text does not answer); s 68(a), (b)(2), (b)(3), (c); s 65(a) 'insured' and 'child' and s 65(b) as far as ss 66-68 need them; s 1 'child' and s 1 'the basic amount' paragraph (2)(a)-(c) as far as s 65 and s 68 need them. Inert: s 65(a)'s note on regulations, s 68(b)(1) (deleted), s 68(d)-(יא) (repealed), s 1 'the Institute' and 'the Administration'. Out of scope: s 1's updating clause and the other limbs of 'the basic amount' (row IL-04's s 1); s 69; s 69A and s 71 (both declined by name where a case reaches them); s 72; s 238; s 381 and the rounding regulations; the Income Tax Ordinance s 121B (row IL-03), the Income Support Law and the Maintenance (Assurance of Payment) Law, whose results are inputs. Days from 1 May 2015; the basic amounts in force are an input, and the National Insurance Institute's published table for 1 May 2015 to 31 December 2026 is a separate module marked not-law. Amounts are before rounding. See NOTES.md sections 1-3.

period_answered.text: days from 1 May 2015 (Economic Efficiency Law 5776-2015 s 29(a)); earlier days declined by name
period_answered.published_figures: 1 May 2015 to 31 December 2026; from 1 January 2027 declined by name

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass was run (the row was briefed as one session with no sub-agents); every expected value in nii-il06-tests.l4 was worked by hand from the text of the Law or from a National Insurance Institute page before it was asserted.

forks.F1: s 65 'his child' carries s 1's extension (stepchild, adopted child) and exclusion (married boy or girl).
forks.F2: Where the calendar has no corresponding day (29 February; three months from the 30th or 31st), dates clamp to the end of the shorter month.
forks.F3: s 65(b): an absence not yet ended is measured from the day of leaving to the day asked about.
forks.F4: The count is ordered by date of birth, eldest first; children born the same day keep the family list's order.
forks.F5: s 66: which tax year's additional-tax liability governs is not decided; the input is the caller's answer for the day.
forks.F6: An insured father excluded by s 66 keeps the children in his count ('the insured father'); no allowance is paid for them.
forks.F7: With one insured parent, the child is in that parent's count wherever the child is.
forks.F8: s 67(b) first limb: the child's own parents (natural or adoptive); second limb: a natural parent and a step-parent or a proven supporter.
forks.F9: s 67(b) second limb, child with both or neither: declined.
forks.F10: Two insured parents both fathers or both mothers: declined (the Institute's same-sex practice noted, not encoded).
forks.F11: Three or more insured parents, or two that fit neither limb: declined.
forks.F12: 'with the mother only' means with her and not with the father.
forks.F13: s 69A 'נשים' read as women, for the refusal gate only.
forks.F14: s 68(c): the parent paid Income Support or maintenance must be the parent in whose count the children are.
forks.F15: s 65 'child' (2): the supporter must be insured.
forks.F16: s 65 'insured' (2): the absence limb is one input, the authorised employee's determination.
forks.F17: s 68(c) 'three or more children': the children in the parent's count, s 68(b) children included.
